PreDistributionSetAsideEvent.description:
One cert distribution event set aside because its cells were minted before the petition was.

The distribution moment's cells forecast from the petition's own
distribution for a conference; a cell minted while only an ancillary paper
(a sealing motion, a motion for leave under a linked M-number) had been
distributed forecast from a moment the petition never reached, so the
record cannot show what moment it stands at. Whether the petition was
distributed in its own right reads the docket entries, which live in the
corpus, so the event is listed rather than computed.

declared.description: The date of the freeze-record entry that sets it aside
declared.title: Declared

minted_run_id.description: The harness run id of the event's forward frozen-scope cells minted before the petition was distributed
minted_run_id.title: Minted Run Id

reason.description: Why its cells are set aside. `pre-distribution-mint`: the event's forward frozen-scope distribution-moment cells were minted when the docket carried a distribution by their run day but none of the petition itself (its own `distribution_count` was zero)
reason.title: Reason

SetAsideEvent.description:
One event whose cells are set aside from the default figures, and the census row behind it.

The reasons a committed artifact alone cannot decide sit here — the
post-conference reason reads the petition's docket entries, which live in
the corpus — so the set-aside is a committed fact every offline board reads
the same way. A reason the committed ledger decides by itself is computed
instead and never listed.

conference.description: The conference that considered the petition
conference.title: Conference

declared.description: The date of the freeze-record entry that sets it aside
declared.title: Declared

first_forward_run_id.description: The harness run id of the event's first forward frozen-scope cell
first_forward_run_id.title: First Forward Run Id

reason.description: Why its cells are set aside. `post-conference-first-forecast`: the event's first forward frozen-scope cell (by harness run id) ran on or after the day the conference that actually considered the petition sat (`cert_signals.considering_conference` reads `sat`)
reason.title: Reason

SetAsideEvent.title: SetAsideEvent

description:
``src/fedcourtsai/set_aside_events.json`` — the listed set-aside events, append-only.

Data rather than code, so a listed set-aside is a reviewed edit to one file,
and a row is never removed: removing one would move a default figure across
a dated entry's boundary.

events.description: The listed events, in the order declared
events.title: Events
